dedupe_keys.name: natural hazards portal new zealand natural hazard insurance claims and hazard maps

description: The Natural Hazards Portal of the New Zealand Natural Hazards Commission lets users look up settled natural hazard insurance property claims across New Zealand, together with information on what natural hazard risk means and on hazards and their impacts, with scenarios and an about section. Natural hazard maps are shown for the Bay of Plenty as a pilot that tests how local hazard information can best be presented, with flooding and landslide maps to follow and other regions to be added over time, while the claims data covers the whole country. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Natural Hazards Portal Terms of Use; third-party data keep their own licences (some non-commercial only). Access is free of charge. Caveats: claims show insured losses settled by the Commission, and hazard maps are so far only a pilot for one region. Coverage is New Zealand. It supports hazard exposure analysis and calibration of loss models for earthquakes, floods, landslides and storms, and resilience planning for property and local infrastructure; related records are the GDV natural hazard loss statistics and the Munich Re NatCatSERVICE.
